en:
MOM: {FD:01}, we're here, honey!{WAIT_CLEAR}It must be tiring riding with our things
in the moving truck.{WAIT_CLEAR}Well, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.{WAIT_CLEAR}How do you like it?
This is our new home!{WAIT_CLEAR}It has a quaint feel, but it seems to be
an easy place to live, don't you think?{WAIT_CLEAR}And, you get your own room, {FD:01}!
Let's go inside.
zh:
妈妈：{FD:01}，我们到了，宝贝！{WAIT_CLEAR}和行李一起坐搬家卡车，
一定很累吧。{WAIT_CLEAR}这里就是未白镇。{WAIT_CLEAR}感觉怎么样？
这就是我们的新家！{WAIT_CLEAR}虽然有些朴素，住起来
应该很舒服，对吧？{WAIT_CLEAR}而且你也有自己的房间了，{FD:01}！
我们进去吧。

en:
MOM: See, {FD:01}?
Isn't it nice in here, too?
zh:
妈妈：看，{FD:01}？
这里也很不错吧？

en:
The mover's POKéMON do all the work
of moving us in and cleaning up after.{WAIT_SCROLL}This is so convenient!{WAIT_CLEAR}{FD:01}, your room is upstairs.
Go check it out, dear!{WAIT_CLEAR}DAD bought you a new clock to mark
our move here.{WAIT_SCROLL}Don't forget to set it!
zh:
搬家工的宝可梦把搬家和
打扫工作全包了。{WAIT_SCROLL}真方便啊！{WAIT_CLEAR}{FD:01}，你的房间在楼上。
去看看吧！{WAIT_CLEAR}爸爸买了个新时钟，
纪念我们搬到这里。{WAIT_SCROLL}别忘了调好时间！

en:
MOM: Well, {FD:01}?{WAIT_CLEAR}Aren't you interested in seeing your
very own room?
zh: 妈妈：怎么了，{FD:01}？{WAIT_CLEAR}不去看看自己的房间吗？

en:
Good! Everything's put away neatly!{WAIT_CLEAR}They finished moving everything in
downstairs, too.{WAIT_CLEAR}POKéMON movers are so convenient!{WAIT_CLEAR}Oh, you should make sure that
everything's all there on your desk.
zh:
好！所有东西都收拾整齐了！{WAIT_CLEAR}楼下的搬家工作
也全部完成了。{WAIT_CLEAR}搬家工宝可梦真方便！{WAIT_CLEAR}对了，你最好检查一下
桌上的东西是否齐全。

en:
It's a Nintendo GameCube.{WAIT_CLEAR}A Game Boy Advance is connected to
serve as the Controller.
zh:
这是一台任天堂GameCube。{WAIT_CLEAR}连接着一台Game Boy Advance，
可作为控制器使用。

en: Want to make your SECRET BASE here?
zh: 想在这里建立你的秘密基地吗？
